Chapter 943: Chapter 8 Overflowing Abundance (Please Subscribe)

“Gifted to me?”

Lin Yuan looked at the round corpulent figure.

Everything on the island, the eighteen dominating realm bizarre trees, three dominating realm secret treasures, and one Chaos Realm secret treasure, all given to him?

“Hahahaha, if it weren’t for the fact that most of the treasures were taken into the Taiyuan Relic by my true body, what you could have received would be ten times more.”

The round corpulent figure ‘Cang Weiyang’ said nonchalantly.

“However, I have one request,”

the round corpulent figure began.

“Please speak, senior,” Lin Yuan immediately responded.

“If one day in the future, you become a Chaos Great Saint, could you go to a place and take on a disciple?” the round corpulent figure said. “This is just a request, and if you aren’t interested by then, you need not do it.”

“Senior, you think too highly of me.”

Lin Yuan sighed.

A Chaos Great Saint?

What is a Great Saint?

Only the likes of His Majesty Xuanhuang and Moyu Tower Master, who are at the pinnacle of the Chaos Realm, are qualified to be known as Great Saints.

They are magnificent beings capable of pursuing a life near Perfect Time, with abilities that reach unimaginable extents, so much so that Lin Yuan suspects that these two Great Saints haven’t completely perished.

Otherwise, why has the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path not yet birthed a twelfth layer?

And as for the evolutionary path that Moyu Tower Master took, Lin Yuan still remains unaware, nor has the stone statue Shen Ji ever mentioned anything about the Moyu Tower Master’s evolutionary path to Lin Yuan.

“This is just my request, but it is up to you whether you undertake it or not,” said the round corpulent figure ‘Cang Weiyang’.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

If he really becomes a Chaos Great Saint, traversing the Chaos Void will just be a thought away; taking on a disciple wouldn’t be difficult at all.

“Then all that I have is entrusted to you.”

The round corpulent figure smiled, then its entire form transformed into a strong light, as numerous pieces of information flooded into Lin Yuan’s mind.

“Ninety-two secret techniques? Are they all dominating realm secret techniques?”

Lin Yuan quickly absorbed all the information, “Chaos Origin Secret Skills?”

The Chaos Origin Secret Skills, a unique secret technique obtained by ‘Cang Weiyang’, can mask one’s own aura, such that even strong beings of the Chaos Realm might not notice unless they observe carefully.

The information left by ‘Cang Weiyang’ suggested that Lin Yuan first cultivate this Chaos Origin Secret Skills.

After all, the occurrence of someone from the dao realm deducing the Chaos Rule within the universe is too shocking. Lin Yuan, coming from within the universe and lacking any background, would likely attract attention from some Chaos Realm powerhouses once this gets out.

Of course, some of these attentions might be well-meaning.

But there could also be malice, and before growing up, ‘Cang Weiyang’ advised Lin Yuan to try his best to conceal this matter.

And the Chaos Origin Secret Skills could help Lin Yuan hide his Chaos Aura, thus even if Lin Yuan still sends avatars to venture out in the outer world, it would be safer.

“Senior Cang Weiyang is thoughtful,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

While he only sent out an avatar, for a Chaos Realm powerhouse, it’s completely possible to use the avatar to locate Lin Yuan’s true body.

Chaos Realm powerhouses, naturally can’t enter the universe, but they can absolutely wait outside the universe.

Waiting for the universe’s cataclysm, Lin Yuan would emerge from inside.

It would be like waiting by a tree stump hoping for a hare to come along.

“Chaos Primordial Unity…”

Lin Yuan immediately began to comprehend the Chaos Origin Secret Skills.

[Your talent is defying the heavens, comprehending the Chaos Origin Secret Skills to a complete level]

Dozens of breaths later, Lin Yuan cultivated this technique to completion.

The Chaos Origin Secret Skills aren’t complicated, it’s merely a technique for concealing aura, so Lin Yuan comprehended it very quickly.

Rustle.

With a thought from Lin Yuan…

His aura completely converged, not a trace of Chaos Qi leaked out.

“This will do.”

Lin Yuan gently took a breath.

Now, outsiders couldn’t tell that his body was condensed from Chaos Qi.

Even if he encountered a Chaos Realm powerhouse, Lin Yuan could also choose to disperse his avatar.

Once the avatar is dispersed, even if remnants of Chaos Qi remain, the origin of the Chaos Qi can’t be confirmed as numerous treasures in the Chaos Void can absorb Chaos Qi.

Of course, encountering a Chaos Realm powerhouse is a completely extreme situation.

Chaos Realm beings all command their territories; it’s not something you can encounter just by saying so.

Even if he truly encountered a Chaos Realm being, given the other party’s status, they wouldn’t deign to give Lin Yuan a second glance.

“Next, to refine this manor core,” Lin Yuan looked toward a dodecahedral crystal stone not far away.

As the imprint left by ‘Cang Weiyang’ dissipated, this manor core was completely unowned, and Lin Yuan could easily refine it.

Hu hu hu.

An hour later.

Lin Yuan successfully refined the core of the cave abode.

Suddenly.

He had full control over the cave abode that stretched for millions of miles.

“Eighteen dominating realm mystical trees?” Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly as he left the Central Palace and approached the eighteen mystical trees around it.

These eighteen mystical trees were cultivated by Cang Weiyang at a great cost.

Every ten million years, these eighteen mystical trees would bear spirit fruits, each fruit worth as much as a Path Splitting Realm weapon.

Currently, the spirit fruits on the eighteen mystical trees added up to more than a thousand, equivalent to a thousand Path Splitting Realm weapons.

And this kind of Path Splitting Realm weapon would regrow every ten million years.

To beings like Cang Weiyang, pinnacle figures of the Dominating Realm, such a span of time was trivial, even to someone of the eleventh layer like Lin Yuan.

“Unfortunately, the spirit fruits on the mystical trees would fall off after a certain period, dissipating if not collected,” Lin Yuan sighed.

There were countless fallen spirit fruits under the eighteen mystical trees; if all these fruits were available, they could cover the expenditure for Lin Yuan to reach the twelfth layer of the “Body of Xuanhuang”.

“These mystical trees are truly money trees, once in ten million years.”

Lin Yuan evaluated the eighteen mystical trees.

…

After observing the condition of each mystical tree, Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred, and he returned to the Central Palace.

Rustling.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with three weapons manifesting in front of him.

The weapon in the middle was a gourd, half a meter in size, colored red and yellow, and faintly emanated terrifying fluctuations, as if everything returned to chaos.

The weapons on both sides were slightly weaker in aura, but still incredibly formidable, far surpassing the clan suppression weapons of peak groups in the Main Universe.

“Dominating Realm treasures, Chaos Realm treasures.”

Lin Yuan examined carefully, “With my current strength, I absolutely can’t activate the Dominating Realm treasures, let alone the Chaos Realm treasures.”

Lin Yuan felt quite helpless.

With his current foundation, stirring a Path Splitting Realm treasure was more than sufficient, but Dominating Realm treasures? Even peak Path Splitting Realm powerhouses would struggle immensely to activate them.

Using a Dominating Realm treasure weapon even once would consume an incredibly frightful amount. A typical Path Splitting Realm powerhouse’s internal universe could be drained.

“But once I reach the twelfth layer, I should be able to activate a Dominating Realm treasure,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As for the Chaos Realm treasures? Being far too advanced, even a senior like Cang Weiyang, pinnacle of the Dominating Realm, only possessed three Chaos Realm treasures.

Two of which he took away, leaving this one gourd behind because it was of no use to him.

The two Chaos Realm treasures Cang Weiyang took, one for offense and one for defense, didn’t help much even with this additional gourd.

“There are some more Path Splitting Realm secret treasures too.” Lin Yuan inventoried the many treasures within the cave abode.

Cang Weiyang only mentioned two Dominating Realm treasures and one Chaos Realm treasure.

Along with the aforementioned eighteen Dominating Realm mystical trees.

But that doesn’t mean there are only these treasures in the cave abode.

Aside from these, there are other treasures, it’s just that Cang Weiyang couldn’t be bothered to elaborate.

“Seven Path Splitting Realm secret treasure weapons…” Lin Yuan’s eyes sparkled, compared to the currently unusable Dominating and Chaos Realm treasures.

These seven Path Splitting Realm secret treasures, Lin Yuan could almost fully utilize.

And the Path Splitting Realm secret treasures specifically collected by Cang Weiyang in the cave abode were all of excellent quality among their kind, surpassing the clan suppression weapons of peak clans in the Main Universe.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he could fully unleash the power of these supreme Path Splitting Realm weapons.

“There’s also the twelfth-layer evolutionary path left by senior Cang Weiyang…” Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted slightly, he grasped the essence momentarily and then shook his head saying, “Sadly, this evolutionary path has already reached a new ultimate existence.”

Cang Weiyang’s real body has fallen who knows how many years ago, and the evolutionary path he practiced wasn’t a secret, naturally, it had already been occupied by the new ultimate existence.

However, Lin Yuan wasn’t too concerned about this, as he wouldn’t follow Cang Weiyang’s evolutionary path anyway. After having a brief sense of the essence and advantages of this path, Lin Yuan stowed away the three secret treasure weapons.

“Chaos Stones…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, a stone emanating pure Chaos Qi appeared in front of him.

Chaos Stones, the ‘universal currency’ of the Chaos Void, equivalent to the Cosmic Crystals within the universe.

The origin of Chaos Stones comes from Chaos Realm powerhouses refining massive amounts of Chaos Qi, and the Chaos Qi within the stones can be directly absorbed.

Whereas the floating Chaos Qi in the Chaos Void contains various types of energy, even Chaos Realm powerhouses can’t directly absorb it.

It is precisely because of the inherent value of Chaos Stones that they serve as the circulating currency in the Chaos Void.

Ordinarily, in the Chaos Void, a hundred Chaos Stones can be exchanged for a regular Path Splitting Realm secret treasure.

But the palace has over ten thousand Chaos Stones left.

Ten thousand plus Chaos Stones could purchase a hundred regular Path Splitting Realm secret treasures, but still far from enough to buy even one Dominating Realm treasure, hence Cang Weiyang didn’t mention it.

“I can feel that absorbing the Chaos Qi in the Chaos Stones would greatly assist the world inside me,” Lin Yuan’s eyes gleamed.

Of course, currently being merely an incarnation, he couldn’t bear to waste the Chaos Stones, planning to send them back to the Main Universe for his true body to try.

“This exploration of the Chaos Void has been of immense help to me.”

Lin Yuan looked energized, not to mention the two most precious Dominating Realm treasures and one Chaos Realm treasure, along with the eighteen Dominating Realm mystical trees.

Just those seven supreme Path Splitting Realm weapons, along with ninety-eight Dominating Realm secret techniques, had already greatly enhanced Lin Yuan’s strength.
